title: The Thessalonians Persecuted by Their Own Countrymen
description: Paul commends the Thessalonians for receiving God's word as it truly is, and tells them that they became imitators of God's churches in Judea. They suffered the same from their own countrymen as the churches in Judea suffered from the Jews – those who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, persecuted the apostles, and hindered the gospel to the Gentiles. Paul concludes by saying that wrath has finally come upon them.
